name: code_map
description: Get the architectural map of a repository: module communities with their key symbols and files, ranked by size. Prefer this over directory listings or file reads when orienting in an unfamiliar codebase -- the answer is pre-indexed. Scope: always the calling session's own repo -- a member session uses its registered work folder, any other session the fleet server's working folder; there is no repo/path scope argument. Fails with E-SELF-NO-WORKFOLDER or E-SELF-NOT-A-REPO (each with a one-line remediation) when that folder is missing or is not a git repository.
